name: Reading List
title: Reading List
description: Track books and articles from your to-read pile through to finished.

cards.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
cards.description: by Martin Kleppmann. The big ideas behind reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems. Recommended by @alice. #backend #architecture

cards.title: Staff Engineer: Leadership Beyond the Management Track
cards.description: by Will Larson. Career paths for senior ICs. @bob says it's essential reading. #career #leadership

cards.title: A Philosophy of Software Design
cards.description: by John Ousterhout. Combat complexity through better abstractions. #architecture #design

cards.title: Working Effectively with Legacy Code
cards.description: by Michael Feathers. Practical strategies for testing and refactoring untested codebases. #testing #refactoring

cards.title: The Pragmatic Programmer (20th Anniversary Edition)
cards.description: by David Thomas & Andrew Hunt. On chapter 5 — 'Bend, or Break'. Taking notes on decoupling and the Law of Demeter. #craft #software

cards.title: Building Microservices (2nd Edition)
cards.description: by Sam Newman. Halfway through. Great chapter on coupling types (domain, temporal, deployment). #backend #architecture

cards.title: Accelerate: The Science of Lean Software and DevOps
cards.description: by Nicole Forsgren, Jez Humble & Gene Kim. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Key takeaway: the four key metrics — deploy frequency, lead time, MTTR, change fail rate. #devops #leadership

cards.title: The Manager's Path
cards.description: by Camille Fournier. ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great framework for thinking about management as a technical skill. Notes: chapter 3 on mentoring was especially useful. #career #leadership
